description: This file contains platform-specific functions for firmware upgrade and configuration procedures in an embedded Linux environment, specifically for OpenWRT. It includes functions for preparing initramfs, managing UBI volumes, setting boot configurations, and executing upgrade routines tailored to specific board models.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the initramfs environment for Xiaomi devices by erasing and formatting specific UBI partitions if the root filesystem is in tmpfs.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes a specified OEM UBI volume from the device, detaching and formatting the UBI partition if necessary.

methods.name: linksys_bootconfig_set_primaryboot
methods.description: Configures the primary boot partition for Linksys devices by copying relevant data and writing to the MTD device.

methods.name: linksys_bootconfig_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares the environment for a firmware upgrade on Linksys devices by updating U-Boot environment variables.

methods.name: linksys_mx_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Prepares the device for upgrade on certain Linksys models, including setting environment variables and managing boot options.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Always returns success, serving as a placeholder for image validation.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific pre-upgrade steps based on the board name, for example preparing Xiaomi devices.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Executes the appropriate upgrade routine depending on the device model, handling UBI volume management and environmental settings.
